title: Schedule of Refund Processing Charges, Crestline Companion Taxes and Fees
content:
A refund of the companion's taxes and fees on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes product carries a refund processing charge when the cancellation was voluntary, read from the most recent trip reinstatement on the certificate or pass. The charge is set by the refund entries already recorded on the certificate or pass with an entry date in the last 12 months, counted back from the handling date.

| Ground of the most recent trip reinstatement | Refund entries already recorded on the certificate or pass in the last 12 months | Refund processing charge |
|---|---|---|
| voluntary cancellation | 4 or more | 9 USD |
| voluntary cancellation | 2 to fewer than 4 | 6 USD |
| voluntary cancellation | fewer than 2 | none |
| Crestline cancellation | any number | none |

## Notes to the schedule

- Every refund entry on the certificate or pass counts, whatever charge it refunded — companion fare, Hawaii surcharge, taxes and fees or phone booking fee — provided its entry date is within the last 12 months.
- Both parts of the condition must hold for a charge: a voluntary cancellation and the stated number of refund entries.

**Hypothetical cases.** A voluntary cancellation on a certificate showing refund entries dated 2, 5 and 9 months ago carries 6 USD; with a fourth such entry it carries 9 USD. A cancellation Crestline made carries none, however many refund entries there are.
